_doc: CMU clips retargeted onto every character (BVH numbers from mocap.cs.cmu.edu, Hahne's 2010 BVH conversion; frame 1 of each is a T-pose and is never used). pick: how the build chooses the stretch it uses (or from_s to fix it); seconds: its length; loop: blended to loop seamlessly; face_ok: a hand may come near the face (none does).

point.what: direct traffic, wave, point: an arm reaching out

cheer.what: very happy: arms up, then hands on hips
